text:
Situation: Valproic acid 250 mg/5 mL oral solution inventory across the three Corvale sites totals 252 eachs. Current daily use is 16.6 eachs, providing a blended 14.7 days on hand. Corvale East has 84 eachs (12.8 days), Corvale General has 139 eachs (17.6 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 29 eachs (13.9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show valproic acid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA. Local supply is limited to approximately two weeks. All five ranked purchasing options are sourced from suppliers not on FDA's shortage list today. None of the supplier labels identify a manufacturing plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Authorize the buyer to place immediate orders with ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. If option 1 cannot fill the full need, authorize the buyer to supplement with Chartwell Governmental & Specialty RX, LLC (option 2) — requires buyer approval.
3. If options 1 and 2 are insufficient, authorize the buyer to use Chartwell RX, LLC (option 3) — requires buyer approval.
4. Direct the buyer to request plant-site information from each supplier before shipment — requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
5. Instruct the buyer to report fill rates and lead times to the P&T committee within five business days — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Do not initiate therapeutic alternatives, dose changes, or allocation protocols at this time; those decisions remain with the treating clinicians and the committee.
